full_reader: role=>{const c=role==='canonical'?sdk.canvas:document.querySelector('#mount canvas[id$="-preview"]');check(c,'missing content surface');const gl=c.getContext('webgl2');check(!gl.isContextLost(),'context lost');const width=c.width,height=c.height,raw=new Uint8Array(width*height*4),bytes=new Uint8Array(raw.length);gl.readPixels(0,0,width,height,gl.RGBA,gl.UNSIGNED_BYTE,raw);for(let y=0;y<height;++y)bytes.set(raw.subarray((height-1-y)*width*4,(height-y)*width*4),y*width*4);let nonzeroAlpha=0;for(let i=3;i<bytes.length;i+=4)if(bytes[i])++nonzeroAlpha;const css=getComputedStyle(c);return{bytes,width,height,nonzeroAlpha,visible:css.display!=='none'&&css.visibility!=='hidden'&&Number(css.opacity)>0,target:c.id};}
live: async stage=>{const r=readROI();const key='live-'+liveIndex++;const saved=await persist(key,r.bytes);const v={stage,at:performance.now(),state:state(),camera:camera(),...r,bytes:undefined,...saved,key};check(referenceCamera===v.camera,'camera changed during fixed-viewport ROI comparison');v.qualifier=qualifySentinel(reference,r.bytes);row.live.push(v);await window.transientMetadata(row);check(v.qualifier.status==='PRESERVED','unrelated ink disappeared at '+stage);}
